heading: INT. TAXIDERMY CONVENTION - HOTEL BALLROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. TAXIDERMY CONVENTION - HOTEL BALLROOM - DAY
Rows of folding tables display mounted pheasants, a wild boar in a bow tie, and one very surprised-looking badger.
A banner overhead reads "STUFFED & PROUD."
PERCIVAL TANG, 50s, tweed jacket, nametag crooked, stands behind a table with a glass case of owls.
Beside him, BIRGITTA LOWE, 40s, in a lab coat, polishes a fox's eye with a handkerchief.
FRANCO BAPTISTE, 30s, goatee and leather apron, argues with HESTER KIMURA, 60s, a judge with a clipboard, about a moose.
LUDO KARLSSON, 20s, a nervous intern, stacks brochures into leaning towers.
A TALL WOMAN, 40s, in a black raincoat and sunglasses, stalks down the aisle and stops at the owl case.
She leans in until her nose nearly touches the glass.
Are these real?
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: Madam, every feather is authentic.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: That's not what I asked.
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: Birgitta and Percival exchange a look.
Hester stops mid-sentence.
Franco keeps arguing with her about the moose.
Ludo knocks over his tower, and brochures scatter.
Franco, the antlers are glued on.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: They are mounted, not glued.
units.name: FRANCO

units.text: I'm looking for a stolen owl.
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: We have forty.
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: This one's white, with a notch in the left wing, named Gerald.
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: Birgitta drops her handkerchief.
Percival coughs.
Ludo freezes with a brochure halfway to his mouth.
Franco finally turns from the moose, and Hester follows his gaze to the woman.
Gerald?
units.name: BIRGITTA

units.text: My late husband's owl.
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: He's taxidermied?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Both of them are.
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: Ludo makes a noise like a kettle.
Everyone stares at him.
I sold Gerald yesterday. On the internet.
units.name: LUDO

units.text: To whom?
units.name: TALL WOMAN

units.text: A man named Dennis.
units.name: LUDO

units.text: The woman removes her sunglasses.
Her eyes are bloodshot and furious.
I'm Zofia Wrobel. And I'd like to speak to Dennis.
units.name: ZOFIA

units.text: Ms. Wrobel, I assure you--
units.name: PERCIVAL

units.text: Percival, I know that you know Dennis.
units.name: ZOFIA

units.text: Percival lowers his head.
Franco shoves the moose out of the way.
Birgitta quietly unlocks the owl case.
Inside, a single white owl with a notched wing glares out at the room.
Oh no.
units.name: BIRGITTA

units.text: Disqualified.
units.name: HESTER
